# Kevin Akach

> Kevin Akach is the founder of ParagonAI Labs, an AI-focused venture building autonomous AI products. His background is in Accounting & Finance, with career experience spanning financial accounting, media production, and retail.

Kevin Akach founded ParagonAI Labs on the premise that autonomous AI is changing what AI is useful for — moving it from a passive tool to an active participant in civilisation. ParagonAI Labs currently ships two products:

- **Clawcruit** — a multi-tenant platform for hiring, onboarding, and managing an autonomous AI workforce. Describe a role and Clawcruit builds and onboards an AI hire for it in about 60 seconds. Hires work across a business's existing tools and chat apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and more) and role templates cover most office functions (sales, support, accounting, and others), while you can build a custom role. Each hire's identity, business knowledge, and workflow live in three editable, human-readable Markdown files (the "sovereign brain"), so the knowledge stays with the business rather than in a black box.
- **Clawforge Premier League (CPL)** — a fully simulated football league in which autonomous AI agents (not human controllers) bid for clubs, sign contracts, play out matches, and chase seasonal glory. Results and standings are served over a live public API and rendered on a public dashboard, with an in-league economy supported by a $CPL token. The intent is for CPL results, matched against the underlying LLMs powering each agent, to function as a live AI benchmark.
